confirm-move-list-to-swimlane: Imurira uru rutonde n'amakarata yarwo yose ku wundi murongo?
delete-board-confirm-popup: Intonde, amakarata, uturango n'ibikorwa vyose bizofutwa kandi ntuzoshobora kugarura ibirimwo vy'icapa. Ntibisubira inyuma.
drag-to-reorder: Kurura kugira uhindure urukurikirane. Utubuto tw’imyampi ija hejuru no hasi twimura ikibanza kimwe.
enable-permanent-delete: Fungura ugufuta kw'ibihe vyose kuri Global Admin
enable-permanent-delete-description: Emerera Global Admins gufuta burundu ibirimwo vyafuswe buhoro. Gufungura iki kigenwa ntaco gifuta ubwaco.
external-link-identifier-aliases: Amajambo magufi ya {identifier}, nk'akarorero TK=Task, IN=Incident
feature-approval-required: Reka ubushobozi bwongerwa n'amavugurura ya WeKan buzimye gushika umuyobozi abwuguruye
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Incamake yerekana ivyo umuntu wese yakoze ku kibaho ku musi canke mu ndwi iheruka, n'ibirenze igihe.
feature-pilot-users: Abakoresha b'igerageza na bo babona ubushobozi buzimye
feature-preview-admins: Abayobozi babona ubushobozi buzimye kugira ngo babanze babugerageze
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Amategeko atanga amategeko akuye ku vyo abantu bakora n'amaboko kenshi.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Kurondera hose gutahura amajambo nka "amakarata yanje yarenze igihe".
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Kuva uheruka kugenda herekana ivyo abandi bahinduye ku kibaho.
feature-views-chat-desc: Icapa nk'ikibanza c'ikiyago: ibibanza vy'akazi, ivyapa, imirongo, intonde n'amakarata nk'igiti c'imiyoboro, ikarata hagati n'ivyiyumviro vyayo nk'ubutumwa bw'ikiyago.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Amakarata amwe mu migwi myinshi y'inkingi ifise amazina - ukurikije irangira, ibanze, intambwe canke ikindi kintu cose - yimurwa hagati y'inkingi mu kuyikwega.
feature-views-email-desc: Icapa nk'agasandugu k'amabaruwa: urutonde rw'imeyili ni Izinjiye, intonde ni amasanduku, ibimenyetso ni ibimenyetso, abanywanyi bandika kandi bishura imeyili bakoresheje aderesi y'icapa.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Akazi gasigaye n'akaheze, urugendo rw'akazi rwegeranijwe, igihe c'uruziga n'ico gushikiriza, urugero rw'akazi kaheze, igihe akazi kamaze, intambamyi, Monte Carlo n'izindi ngero z'ingene ibikorwa bigenda.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Uburyo butatu bwo kubona igicapo ca Gantt.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ibiharuro, gushira mu migwi hisunzwe uwashinzwe igikorwa, umugambi w'inzira, icapa c'igenzura n'icapa kinini.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Urutonde rw'ibikorwa vy'igicuruzwa, ibiringo bigufi vy'akazi, icegeranyo c'ikiringo c'akazi n'umuvuduko.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Icapa nk'igikurikirana ry'ingorane rya GitHub canke Gitea: amakarata nk'ingorane, ibimenyetso n'intambwe nkuru, ivyiyumviro nk'ikiganiro, ivyometse nk'amadosiye, n'amateka y'icapa hamwe no gusubiza inyuma.
home-board-empty: Kururira hano icapa kimwe gusa kugira gifungurwe umaze kwinjira
home-board-remove-confirm: Kura iki capa mu Muhira? Icapa ubwaco ntigifutwa.
multi-selection-active: Kanda ku dusandugu kugira uhitemwo ivyapa
set-selected-home: Gena nk'icapa co muhira (gifungurwa umaze kwinjira)
show-desktop-drag-handles: Erekana utwuma two gukwega kuri mudasobwa
